notes: 55" 4K HDR professional/commercial display (Android TV-based BRAVIA Pro BZ40L series), 700 nits, VESA 300x300mm, no rack mounting (wall/tabletop mount only). Port list drawn from Sony's official FW-55BZ40L Reference Manual "Input/Output Jacks" specification section (mirrored at manualowl.com, page 18/68 of the EN PDF: manualowl.com/m/Sony/FW-55BZ40L/Manual/703569?page=18) plus the official pro.sony spec/overview page, cross-checked against B&H Photo's published spec table (bhphotovideo.com, product 1774438-REG). HDMI grade (2.0) is inferred from Sony's documented max supported timings (4096x2160p/3840x2160p up to 60Hz only; no 4K120 or 8K, which are exclusive to the larger 98" FW-98BZ50L/98BZ30L variants of this same manual) rather than an explicit "HDMI 2.0" label; HDCP 2.3 is supported on all four HDMI inputs. This 55" model does NOT have the S-CENTER SPEAKER IN jack that appears on the 98" BZ50L/BZ30L variants covered in the same shared manual. Power inlet connector type is inferred (Sony's manual only states electrical ratings, 110-240VAC 50/60Hz, 201W typical/0.5W standby; B&H separately lists "Power Adapter Type: Internal" and a "Power Cord" as an included accessory, consistent with a detachable IEC inlet, but the exact IEC variant was not visually confirmed). Also includes Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) and Bluetooth 4.2 wireless (not modeled as physical ports).

ports.name: AV IN
ports.note: Video/Audio input mini-jack; carries composite video + stereo audio via breakout cable

ports.name: HDMI IN 3
ports.note: Also supports eARC/ARC audio return (Dolby Atmos/DTS:X/Dolby TrueHD/DTS-HD MA passthrough)

ports.name: HDMI IN 4
ports.note: Can double as a DVI input via DVI-HDMI adapter; pairs with HDMI 4 AUDIO IN for analog sound in DVI mode

ports.name: HDMI 4 AUDIO IN
ports.note: Analog stereo audio input used only when HDMI IN 4 is fed via a DVI-HDMI adapter

ports.name: REMOTE
ports.note: RS-232C external control input, physically a 3.5mm mini-jack; Sony includes a 1/8" to DB-9 adapter cable in the box

ports.name: AC IN
ports.note: Internal power supply with detachable power cord included; exact IEC inlet variant (C13/C14) not explicitly stated by Sony, inferred from included cord + 'internal' adapter type
